latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Blog Generator for OpenClaw.

- Analyzes journal entries and chat history to identify high-value topics.
- Automatically generates blog posts in HTML (X-article format) with structured sections (overview, problem, solution, takeaways).
- Scores and selects topics by relevance, content depth, and search volume indicators.
- Designed to run as a scheduled cron job or manually for ad-hoc generation.
- Supports article humanization via pluggable humanizer; integrates with visual-explainer for headers.
- Outputs blog posts to a dedicated folder with timestamped filenames.
